# Regional Totals Summary Report

## Overview
This report summarizes financial records by geographic region.

## Data Summary
- **Total Records Processed**: 18 records
- **Record Range**: R002-R024 (6 records missing from expected range)
- **Processing Status**: Completed

## Regional Breakdown
| Region | Total (cents) | Total (USD) |
|--------|---------------|------------|
| South  | 368,067       | $3,680.67  |
| West   | 374,056       | $3,740.56  |
| North  | 377,979       | $3,779.79  |

## Summary
The analysis of 18 available records shows fairly balanced distribution across the three regions, with North region having the highest total at $3,779.79, followed by West at $3,740.56, and South at $3,680.67. The combined total across all regions is $11,201.02 (1,120,102 cents).

## Data Quality Notes
The input file contained 18 records. Six record IDs from the expected R001-R024 range were not present in the dataset (R001, R005, R009, R013, R017, R021).
